 WTA Hong Kong Semifinal Predictions Including Alexandra Eala vs Maria Sakkari 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The semifinals are set at the 2026 WTA Hong Kong Open and feature an equal mix of seeded and unseeded players. The marquee match is between second seed Alexandra Eala and fourth seed Maria Sakkari, although Claire Liu and qualifier Alexandra Shubladze could also be exciting. As always, we at LWOT will offer predictions for both matches, but which players will advance to the final?
 WTA Hong Kong Semifinal Predictions
 Claire Liu vs Alexandra Shubladze
 Head-to-Head : first meeting
 21-year-old Alexandra Shubladze has been the story of this tournament. Making her first WTA main-draw appearance, the Russian qualifier has ridden a wave of momentum to reach the semifinals. Shubladze got the biggest win of her career in the quarterfinals, upsetting top seed Sorana Cirstea in straight sets and ending Cirstea’s career . Shubladze is guaranteed a new career-high whether she wins the semifinal or not.
 Claire Liu has been in fantastic form lately and has made the most of it this week. She hasn’t dropped a set so far and easily outplayed Zeynep Sonmez in the quarterfinal. Shubladze is on a dream run, but Liu’s experience at this level and current form make her the slight favourite.
 Prediction: Liu in 3 
 Mar 6, 2025; Indian Wells, CA, USA; Claire Liu (USA) hits a ball against Polina Kudermetova in the BNP Paribas Open at the Indian Well Tennis Garden. Mandatory Credit: Jonathan Hui-Imagn Images 
 Alexandra Eala vs Maria Sakkari
 Head-to-Head : first meeting
 It was another tussle for Alexandra Eala in the quarterfinal against Antonia Ruzic, but she will be pleased with the way she fought under pressure. It was a grueling straight-sets battle with several long games. She will need to rest and recover to her full potential before facing Maria Sakkari in the semifinals, who won her quarterfinal match much more easily. I expect Eala to be better than in her previous matches, but I feel more confident in Sakkari’s game this week. Eala’s serve has been vulnerable, and Sakkari should take advantage to reach her second final of the season.
 Prediction: Sakkari in 3
